messages:
Ana (marketing): Quick sync — embargo lift Wed 11:00 PT. Need 1-line changelog, docs anchor, RSVP page, benchmark stat for the blog, and lead routing rules. Can we lock canary window?
Vik (eng): Canary Wed 08:00 PT -> 12:00 PT (4h). Ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Auto-rollback on >2.5% error or p95 spike > 1.5x.
Ana (marketing): Nice. Leah, exact docs url to point at?
Leah (docs): Docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2. Changelog anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v2-3-2#changelog. Migration note under "Breaking changes".
Ravi (product): Changelog blurb recommendation: "Adaptive KV caching reduces long-context p95 by ~12–18% depending on workload." Use the shorter phrase for headline.
Carmen (growth): RSVP page draft: https://redwood.ai/events/v2-3-launch (will add GA params). Proposed UTMs: utm_source=announce&utm_campaign=v2_3_launch&utm_medium=email.
Ana (marketing): Embed a tiny config example for the blog: Leah, can you paste code we can inline?
Leah (docs): Sure — short snippet: ```
# enable adaptive kv cache
client.configure(cache='adaptive', batching=True)
```
Carmen (growth): I'll publish landing at 09:30 PT so we can QA before embargo lift. Social schedule: first post at +1h, follow-ups +6h and next day.
Vik (eng): Heads up: please avoid sending heavy traffic to API docs in first 20m after lift. We'll monitor trace for cache warmup.
Ana (marketing): We'll do staggered email sends: wave A (+30m), wave B (+4h). Also holding a small press list — embargo copy will be DM'd.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary start 1716595200, full ramp expected 1716602400. Monitor: https://infra.redwood.ai/deploys/xyz123
Ravi (product): For sales routing: RSVP -> SFDC Campaign "v2_3_launch_2026". High-value filter: employee_count > 500 => AE queue "Enterprise-West". Carmen, can you load mapping?
Carmen (growth): Yep, pushing mappings now. Will test with a demo RSVP after landing page up.
Carmen (growth): Test RSVP passed: SFDC tag applied and AE queue assignment correct.
Ana (marketing): Final ask: can someone produce a single-sentence benchmark line + attached p95 chart for the blog hero?
Vik (eng): Use: "~15% p95 improvement on long histories (typical RLHF prompts)" — I'll drop the p95 graph in #marketing-assets by EOD.
Leah (docs): Migration callout: "No client changes required; opt-in for adaptive cache using config flag" — pinned on top of release notes.
Ana (marketing): Great. I'll assemble announcement draft and post in #marketing-drafts for signoff at 10:15 PT. Thanks everyone :rocket:
